scope: Offline independent review of recovery helper; not execution approval of unreviewed app source
observations: Exact source guard before Store or mutation; existing evidence file cannot be overwritten.
Only mutation mechanism is existing Brain.flush; no deletion, canonical-manifest update, fabricated raw identity or outbox skip.
Ledger guard before start and every batch; max50 batches and max500 per batch (25000 deliveries); count capped to pending cutoff count.
Cutoff defines completion target, not exact exclusion of concurrent newer events; explicitly documented.
Read-only snapshots require all three retained datasets REAL/FAIL with empty canonical paths; hash complete canonical rows and validate raw-file checksums beneath data/raw.
After replay asserts unchanged canonical/raw snapshot, three Core-owned graph nodes REAL/FAIL with zero NORMALIZED_INTO edges.
Any flush error/no progress fails immediately and preserves evidence; tested without actual DB or graph calls.
limits: The 40-minute deadline is checked between batches, not a hard interruption of in-flight flush or file hashing.
No production execution/flush, DB writes or provider calls performed by QA.
Actual graph acceptance and retained-data equality remain runtime assertions, not yet observed.
final_wording: Final source explicitly states deadline admission occurs between batches and does not interrupt an in-flight flush/hash.
